title: Qwen-Image-Flash: Beyond Objective Design
authors: Qwen Team (Sole First Author)
summary: The paper presents Qwen-Image-Flash, showing that efficient 4-step image generation and editing distillation depends not only on the loss objective, but also critically on data composition, multi-teacher guidance, and the generation-editing task mix.

title: Diversity-Preserved Distribution Matching Distillation for Fast Visual Synthesis
authors: Tianhe Wu*, Ruibin Li*, Lei Zhang, Kede Ma
summary: A simple yet effective approach to preserving sample diversity under DMD, with no perceptual backbone, no discriminator, no auxiliary networks, and no additional ground-truth images.

title: VisualQuality-R1: Reasoning-Induced Image Quality Assessment via Reinforcement Learning to Rank
authors: Tianhe Wu, Jian Zou, Jie Liang, Lei Zhang, Kede Ma
summary: A reasoning-enabled visual quality model capable of delivering both qualitative descriptions and quantitative ratings without perceptual alignment.

title: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL Technical Report
authors: Qwen Team
summary: We present Qwen-Image-2.0-RL, a post-training pipeline that combines RLHF, composite reward models, GRPO-based training, and on-policy distillation to improve image generation and editing quality.

title: Qwen-Image-Agent: Bridging the Context Gap in Real-World Image Generation
authors: Qwen Team
summary: We introduce Qwen-Image-Agent, a context-centric framework that uses planning, reasoning, search, memory, and feedback to improve real-world image generation.

title: Qwen-RobotWorld Technical Report: Unifying Embodied World Modeling through Language-Conditioned Video Generation
authors: Qwen Team
summary: We introduce Qwen-RobotWorld, a language-conditioned video world model that predicts future visual trajectories across embodied AI scenarios.

title: Qwen-Image-VAE-2.0 Technical Report
authors: Qwen Team
summary: Qwen-Image-VAE-2.0 introduces a high-compression VAE that achieves state-of-the-art image reconstruction and diffusion-friendly latent representations, especially for text-rich images, through global skip connections, large-channel latents, and semantic alignment training.

title: Qwen-Image-2.0 Technical Report
authors: Qwen Team (As the core contributor to this project)
summary: Qwen-Image-2.0 is an omni-capable image generation foundation model that integrates high-fidelity image creation and precise image editing into a single unified framework.

title: Tool-IQA: Augmenting Image Quality Assessment with Simple Tools
authors: Guanyi Qin, Junjie Zhang, Chunming He, Yibing Fu, Jie Liang, Tianhe Wu, Lei Zhang
summary: We propose Tool-IQA, a VLM-based image quality assessment framework that improves over one-shot scoring by using rubric notes, a Magnifier, a Gamma Corrector, and BATE-guided GRPO training for more accurate calibrated quality prediction.

title: Qwen-Image-Bench: From Generation to Creation in Text-to-Image Evaluation
authors: Qwen Team
summary: Qwen-Image-Bench is a creator-centric benchmark for evaluating text-to-image models with fine-grained, expert-aligned scoring.

title: Smaller Models are Natural Explorers for Policy-Level Diversity in GRPO
authors: Yiming Ren, Yiran Xu, Zicheng Lin, Chufan Shi, Yukang Chen, Dingdong Wang, Tianhe Wu, Jujie Wang, Yujiu Yang, Yu Qiao, Ruihang Chu
summary: S2L-PO uses smaller models as diverse explorers to train larger reasoning models more efficiently.

title: Long-Horizon Streaming Video Generation via Hybrid Attention with Decoupled Distillation
authors: Ruibin Li, Tao Yang, Fangzhou Ai, Tianhe Wu, Shilei Wen, Bingyue Peng, Lei Zhang
summary: Hybrid Forcing enables faster, more stable long-form streaming video generation.

title: ME-IQA: Memory-Enhanced Image Quality Assessment via Re-Ranking
authors: Kanglong Fan, Tianhe Wu†, Wen Wen, Jianzhao Liu, Le Yang, Yabin Zhang, Yiting Liao, Junlin Li, Li Zhang
summary: Training-free method for alleviating scoring collapse in generative visual quality perception models.

title: Beyond Length Scaling: Synergizing Breadth and Depth for Generative Reward Models
authors: Qiyuan Zhang, Yufei Wang, Tianhe Wu, Can Xu, Qingfeng Sun, Kai Zheng, Xue Liu, Chen Ma
summary: Test time scaling for generative reward models.

title: DP2O-SR: Direct Perceptual Preference Optimization for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
authors: Rongyuan Wu, Lingchen Sun, Zhengqiang Zhang, Shihao Wang, Tianhe Wu, Qiaosi Yi, Shuai Li, Lei Zhang
summary: Direct perceptual preference optimization for image super-resolution.

title: The Unanticipated Asymmetry Between Perceptual Optimization and Assessment
authors: Jiabei Zhang*, Qi Wang, Siyu Wu, Du Chen, Tianhe Wu*†
summary: Our comprehensive study highlights the asymmetries between assessment and optimization.

title: Toward Generalized Image Quality Assessment: Relaxing the Perfect Reference Quality Assumption
authors: Du Chen*, Tianhe Wu*, Kede Ma, Lei Zhang
summary: A generalized FR-IQA model for low-level vision, applicable to both perfect and imperfect reference scenarios.

title: A Comprehensive Study of Multimodal Large Language Models for Image Quality Assessment
authors: Tianhe Wu, Kede Ma, Jie Liang, Yujiu Yang, Lei Zhang
summary: A systematic study on the ability of multimodal large language models to perceive and assess image quality.

title: Assessor360: Multi-sequence Network for Blind Omnidirectional Image Quality Assessment
authors: Tianhe Wu*, Shuwei Shi*, Haoming Cai, Mingdeng Cao, Jing Xiao, Yinqiang Zheng, Yujiu Yang
summary: We present a new framework for blind omnidirectional IQA.

title: Attentions Help CNNs See Better: Attention-based Hybrid Image Quality Assessment Network
authors: Shanshan Lao*, Yuan Gong*, Shuwei Shi, Sidi Yang, Tianhe Wu, Jiahao Wang, Weihao Xia, Yujiu Yang
summary: The champion method for NTIRE2022 FR IQA.

title: MANIQA: Multi-dimension Attention Network for No-Reference Image Quality Assessment
authors: Sidi Yang*, Tianhe Wu*, Shuwei Shi, Shanshan Lao, Yuan Gong, Mingdeng Cao, Jiahao Wang, Yujiu Yang
summary: The champion method for NTIRE2022 NR IQA.
